newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Annan to visit Hague, China, Japan, Russia, Austria.
newsitem.headline: Annan to visit Hague, China, Japan, Russia, Austria.

text.p: Secretary-General Kofi Annan will pay official visits next month to China, Japan, Russia and Austria after attending the first conference of the parties to the Chemical Weapons Convention at The Hague, a U.N. spokesman said on Monday.
The Convention, which enters into force on Tuesday, seeks to outlaw the production, stockpiling, transfer and use of chemical weapons worldwide.
The Hague, which Annan will visit May 5 and 6, is the seat of the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons, being set up to police the convention.
The secretary-general, who earlier this month visited India, Switzerland, Italy and Germany, will pay an official visit to China from May 7 to 11.
That will be followed by official visits to Japan (May 11-14), Moscow (May 14-18) and Austria (May 18-21). While in Vienna he will also visit U.N. agencies based in the Austrian capital.
Last month Annan made an extensive trip to a number of African countries, including South Africa, while in late February and early March he visited Britain, France and the Netherlands.
